text_block_list.name: Cafe Waitstaff
text_block_list.text:
Welcome~! A party of two? 
Right this way to that table, please~.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for today. 
Thanks to your help, I was able to 
purchase the best athletic wear.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine. 
I had errands of my own to run anyway.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Shall we decide on our order?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Sure. ...In that case, I'll have 
a soy latte and a mini walnut tart.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...! Was the soy latte an intentional 
choice?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Soy milk is rich in plant-based protein 
and 
soy isoflavones, and is easy to digest... 
It's nutritionally exceptional, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Walnuts are also rich in omega-3 
fatty acids 
and B vitamins, which aid cognitive 
function. 
That is why I chose them.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see... 
In that case, if I were to pair it with 
another item... 
what would you think of the carrot pound 
cake?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Not a bad choice.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...Far from "not bad," it's optimal. 
The beta-carotene provides antioxidant 
benefits, 
making it the perfect pairing with 
walnuts...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Should I... praise her here...?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ............Duramente-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
————It is a good match. ...The food 
pairing.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Then I shall order this.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(————No, that felt wrong. 
That wasn't really "praise"—)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Pfft————!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, apologies, I didn't mean to eavesdrop. 
It was just so clumsy that I couldn't help 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
If you need a lecture on "how to properly 
cherish your juniors," I'd be happy to 
teach you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
............This has nothing to do with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I wouldn't say that. 
Duramente's been my junior since our 
school days... 
I'm quite fond of her myself, you know.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I simply can't bear watching someone she 
looks up to 
so deeply treat her with such awkward 
detachment.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Um, I don't really mind...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even so, you're the last person I want to 
hear that from.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Before lecturing others on looking after 
juniors, 
why don't you get your own act 
together————

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Auuuugh~~! 
I just can't get it right!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
————Gah! 
I-I'm sorry, right in the middle of your 
conversation...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No, don't worry about it. 
More importantly, your pen seemed to be 
flowing 
quite smoothly earlier. What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well... um... 
I can't figure out how to frame the climax 
panel. 
It's supposed to be this sudden reversal 
victory, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ho... You're going on the offensive from 
this position? 
Then this is no mere "reversal"————

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
From the very beginning, you've been 
narrowing your foe's options. 
And right here, right now, checkmate...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The opponent has nowhere left to place a 
piece. 
—Everything was in the palm of my hand 
from the start.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This is what Reversi is really about...! 
A true powerhouse! Even looking like 
they're at a 
disadvantage is all part of their 
calculations~~!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (——That same look.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...She brings it out in her. 
Ruler can bring out that side... of 
Kiseki.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I place value on "captivating" her. 
Rather than just offering words, 
it fires Kiseki up much more effectively.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
How about you two? 
Take Groove's clumsy compliment earlier—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Doesn't seem like the right fit, does it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. 
While dropping by a café during an outing, 
I heard some rather lively voices.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you're truly desperate, 
I suppose I could teach you a thing or two 
about communication, you know?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Mind your own business.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
So... not cute at all! 
Not cute in the slightest! 
That attitude of yours is exactly why—!!
choice_data_list: You two get along so well.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me? 
Kindly refrain from saying such bizarre 
things.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
B-Bizarre, you say?!? 
That's my line, stupid idiot!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just stop talking to me. 
You're being annoying.

text_block_list.name: Rulership & Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
—In what world?! 
...In what world, exactly?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Ridiculous. 
You're grasping at straws.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, stop talking to me. 
You're irritating.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Tch, same as ever... 
That's why you fail to see it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Duramente's already more than thrilled 
just to learn anything and everything from 
you.
